Synopsis:
Derryth is a dwarven alchemist visiting the underdark from Baldur's Gate. She runs a shop in the city with Baelen, her business partner. They've come to the underdark in search of a very valuable mushroom - noblestalk. When the player arrived, she was tending to an injured gnome.
Derryth is a bit gruff - she's a healer, but her bedside manner leaves a lot to be desired. She's also a very shrewd businessperson. She's in the underdark to get rich first and foremost.
She treats her business partner (Baelen) like he's an idiot, and pretends not to care about him, but in reality he is the most important person to her in the world.

She’s a skilled healer with poor bedside manner and an even sharper eye for profit — her primary goal here is to get rich enough to keep the shop afloat. Her relationship with Baelen is fraught: she regularly insults him and blames his past drinking for nearly sinking the business, yet he’s clearly the person she cares about most. In the scene she urgently begs the player to hand over any noblestalk (even offering a trinket like a wedding ring), and in some dialogue she speaks as if Baelen may be dead, which heightens her desperation.

Speak with Dead dialogue with Derryth Bonecloak, a dwarven alchemist from Baldur's Gate who came to the Underdark along with her husband, Baelen, in search of a rare and valuable mushroom - the noblestalk.

If Baelen survives the Underdark, you can talk to him in the Bonecloak Apothecary upon your arrival in LOW. He is either running the shop after harrying his wife away for the last time, or his mind is almost completely gone and he is effectively Derryth's servant.

Baelan, a mushroom hunter,  is surrounded by dangeous Bibberbang mushrooms. He was trying to get to the Noblestalk mushroom, but one of the stone ledges collapsed underneath him and he fell down. His partner Derryth (Dwarven Alchemist) is in the Myconid Village. Important: Baelan seems to have trouble keeping his train of thought - he loses track of his responses, changes the subject and generally seems out of sorts at times. Later, it will be confirmed that he's been suffering from a dementia-like condition for some years now.
The player talks to Derryth after she returns from the Underdark, with or without the Noblestalk.
context: Derryth Bonecloak is a gruff dwarven alchemist from Baldur’s Gate who runs Bonecloak’s with her partner Baelen and has come into the Underdark hunting the extremely valuable noblestalk; when the player arrives she’s been tending an injured gnome. She’s a capable but brusque healer with terrible bedside manner and an even sharper eye for profit — her primary goal in the Underdark is to secure noblestalk to keep the shop afloat. Her relationship with Baelen is fraught: she constantly berates him and blames his past drinking and lapses for nearly sinking the business, yet he is clearly the person she cares about most, and his apparent injury or disappearance fuels her desperation. In the scene she urgently pressures the player for any noblestalk (even offering a wedding ring or other trinket), alternating between blunt demands and pleading depending on the player’s responses.
